name: Glamerforge Fanfare
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level bard 1, wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Every physical action you perform produces wordless music in addition to any other sound it would normally make.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Intimidate and Perform checks. Your musical accompaniment produces the sound of any instrument or combination of instruments you desire, but its volume is always equal to that of a single performer.

This music originates from your location whenever you perform a physical action. It can be noticed with a DC -10 Perception check and its location pinpointed with a DC 10 Perception check.
